clips.title: The story
paras: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts is a task undertaken on behalf of Kristy Grant, a traveler seeking the radiant coats of the Pesterhide hyenas in Thousand Needles. Lacking combat training herself, Kristy relies on capable adventurers to hunt the beasts and harvest their pelts. Her goal is to send these unique hides back across the sea to her sisters in Stormwind, where they can be fashioned into fine garments and goods.

Far from the bustling cobblestone avenues of Stormwind, Kristy Grant finds herself traveling through the arid, sun-baked canyon floor of Thousand Needles. While observing the local wildlife, she is struck by the striking hue and quality of the coats worn by the native Pesterhide hyenas. Recognizing that such distinct pelts are virtually unknown in the Eastern Kingdoms, Kristy envisions sending a shipment of hides back home to her sisters. In her eyes, the pelts represent not only a piece of the Kalimdor frontier, but raw material that skilled family hands in the kingdom can transform into something truly extraordinary.

Despite her eye for craft and trade, Kristy Grant is no warrior and possesses no combat experience to face the ferocious predators of the canyon herself. The Pesterhide hyenas are vicious pack scavengers that roam the dusty expanses beneath the towering mesas, making the harvesting of pristine pelts dangerous for any lone traveler. To secure five unblemished hides without risking her own neck, Kristy enlists the aid of seasoned adventurers passing through the needles. The task requires venturing out into the wilderness, overcoming the territorial beasts, and carefully collecting the hides needed for her family's crafting ventures back home.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!
I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.
I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
